result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe or Shopify Payments**, depending on what platform your store uses. If you're selling in Canada, I'd also put **Helcim** on your shortlist.

Here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best payment processors for a small online store

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall for flexibility)

- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Accepts major credit and debit cards and digital wallets.
- Excellent integrations with ecommerce platforms.
- Good tools for subscriptions and international sales.

Best if you have WooCommerce, a custom website, or want flexibility.

[Canadian pricing](https://stripe.com/ca/pricing)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and payment management.
- No additional Shopify third-party transaction fee when using Shopify Payments.
- Easy refunds and order reconciliation.

Best if your store is already built on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments details](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Helcim**

(Best for competitive processing costs)

- Canadian payment processor.
- Interchange-plus pricing.
- No monthly account fee on standard plans.
- Particularly worth considering as sales volume grows.

Best if keeping transaction costs down is a priority.

[Helcim pricing](https://www.helcim.com/pricing/)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Recognizable and trusted by many shoppers.
- Offers PayPal checkout and card payment options.
- Easy to add to many ecommerce platforms.

Best as an additional checkout option rather than necessarily your only processor.

[PayPal business services](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

## My recommendation

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a new online store | Stripe |
| Already using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Want lower fees as sales grow | Helcim |
| Want customers to have more payment choices | Add PayPal |


These are general recommendations, not a guarantee that one processor will have the lowest total cost. Pricing depends on card type, transaction volume, currency and platform fees.
